## Activity

During July 2019, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 87 captures. This figure represents the imaging activity reported for the site during the month. The activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes in this report. The capture total is considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the number of results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 87 captures, 6 were marked ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 6.9. These images could not be used for grading, and the ungradable total is reported separately from the captures that proceeded to assessment. This provides a clear record of image quality for Oakridge Primary Care in July 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results from the activity recorded during July 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure records the central turnaround for graded images during the reporting period. Together, the grading total and median lag describe the reported grading outcome for the site.
